newsitem.title: USA: Northern says Minn. power plant back Wed.
newsitem.headline: Northern says Minn. power plant back Wed.

text.p: Northern States Power Co's 544 megawatt (MW) Monticello nuclear power plant is expected to resume full power production by late Wednesday after tripping off line early this morning, the company said Tuesday.
The unit, in Monticello, Minn., tripped off line due to an operator error and involved no mechanical problems, a spokeswoman said.
"We expect it to be back at full power by tomorrow night," she said.

About 35 percent of the company's power production comes from the Monticello facility and its two Prairie Island units in Red Wing, Minn. The three nuclear units have an overall production capacity of 1,547 MW.
